rows.statusReason: The opt-in was made exactly as Vermont's is -- one option, suppressSynthesizedAppearances, carried per document through finalizeOfficialForm, default-off for every other caller -- and it changed not one byte of this family's fixtures, because on this host the synthesized square is already painted BEFORE the finalizer is called. scripts/build-census-v1-nj_arrest_no_conviction-set.mjs finalizeEastOfficialForm neutralizes the source's choices (deletes /V and /DV, forces every button widget to /AS /Off) and then writes preparedSourceBytes with sourceDoc.save({ useObjectStreams: false, updateMetadata: false }). pdf-lib's save() defaults updateFieldAppearances to true, so it regenerates an appearance for exactly the condition FIX50 describes -- a current /AS state with no stream in /AP /N -- and stamps a stroked square into /AP /N /Off of all 22 widgets in the bytes the finalizer then receives. By the time suppressSynthesizedSelectionAppearances runs, every widget's current state already has a stream, so it correctly installs nothing: installedCount 0, skippedStateAlreadyDrawn 22, on both fixtures. Measured directly on the pinned source in this container: saving the neutralized document with the pdf-lib default gives 22 of 22 widgets an /Off stream; saving it with updateFieldAppearances: false gives 0 of 22. Clearing the square here therefore needs a change to the host's own pre-finalize save, which is not the one option this assignment authorizes and is not made. The builder edit was reverted; the three family directories are byte-identical to base 760c6285d.
rows.obligationsRepairedNote: Claimed and worked as the one obligation this lane holds. It is NOT delivered on these bytes: the status above is STOPPED and the per-widget measurement below shows the square still present. The name is recorded here because it is what this lane opted the family in to repair and what a later lane must finish, never as a discharge.
obligationsThisRowDoesNotDischarge: RASTER. No central raster was run and none is owed on new bytes, because this lane produced no new bytes. Each family's standing RASTER_PASS receipt still binds the fixtures on disk exactly, since those fixtures did not move. RASTER_QUEUE.json and MASTER_QUEUE.json were read and never opened for writing.

INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION. None. This lane made and reverted a change on the shared host and measured these families itself, so it verifies nothing. No verdict was written or replaced and no acceptance receipt was created.

THE OTHER FAMILIES ON THIS HOST. nj_arrest_no_conviction-set, nj_clean_slate-set and the two New York families share finalizeEastOfficialForm and the same pre-finalize save, so the same square is expected on any of them that ships a widget without an /Off appearance. None was claimed, opened for writing, measured or rebuilt here, and nothing in this row should be read as clearing or condemning them.

THE HOST-LEVEL FIX ITSELF. Passing updateFieldAppearances: false to the neutralization save in scripts/build-census-v1-nj_arrest_no_conviction-set.mjs, or otherwise moving the square's birth to a point the opt-in can reach, is the change these three families need. It is a change to the host's write path rather than one option through the finalizer, it would move the bytes of every family the host builds, and it is left to whoever holds that decision.

A PRE-EXISTING TEXT DRIFT FOUND IN PASSING. At base 760c6285d, with no source change at all, rebuilding any of the three families rewrites participant-instructions.md and reports/actual-writes.json: the committed text is missing a 'Values this platform holds but did not print' section the current host emits, and its actual-writes refusal rows differ. Reproduced with the working tree clean before this lane edited anything, so it is not introduced here; it is reported and not repaired, and the tree was restored.

perWidgetMeasurement.method: Every page of both fixtures rastered with pdftoppm at 150 dpi, greyscale, into /tmp, before the edit and again after the opt-in build; a pixel is ink below 200. The pinned form itself was rastered at the same settings and the same rectangles measured, so each rect is read against the form's OWN ink rather than against a threshold. Rasters deleted after measuring.
